summary: On-page audit inspected 100 indexable pages. Discovered 4 issues with score 43/100.

findings.title: Title Tags Truncated in SERP (>60 chars)
findings.description: 24 page(s) have title tags exceeding 60 characters.
findings.impact: Search engines will truncate the title with ellipses ('...'), reducing click-through rates.
findings.recommendation: Trim title tags to 50-60 characters and move primary keywords to the beginning.

findings.title: Missing Meta Descriptions
findings.impact: Search engines will generate arbitrary text snippets from page content, hurting SERP CTR.
findings.recommendation: Write unique, persuasive meta descriptions (120-160 characters) with a clear call to action.

findings.title: Missing H1 Headings
findings.description: 4 page(s) are missing a main `<h1>` heading tag.
findings.impact: Users and search engines rely on H1 to understand the primary topic of the page.
findings.recommendation: Ensure every page has exactly one descriptive `<h1>` matching the page intent.

findings.title: Images Missing Alt Text
findings.description: Detected 230 image(s) lacking descriptive alt attributes across 100 page(s).
findings.impact: Harms accessibility (screen readers) and prevents images from indexing in Google Image search.
findings.recommendation: Add meaningful `alt='...'` descriptions to all informational images.
